start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:hold-us-to-it for our shared pursuit pursuit:example-bakery-team since yesterday: find what Sam and Alex agreed to, put it on the calendar and tell the group who kept it."
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: the agreements are kept, calendared and scored by tool:hold-to-it in the shared pursuit.
instructions: 1. Name the shared pursuit (space_id) and, if you like, since (the default is the last day) and about (one thing someone said); none are required.
2. Say "Run workflow:hold-us-to-it". The AI reads the meetings, messages, voice memos and transcripts since then and lists every agreement with who agreed, how often and a quote.
3. It keeps each one with tool:hold-to-it (operation keep): posted in the space, the next meeting booked, a reminder before and a check after.
4. After a meeting has happened it runs operation check, marks each person came, missed or not arranged, says it in the pursuit, and gives the scorecard.
